'''Freedon Nadd's Holocron''' was created by [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] and [[King/Legends|King]] of [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] [[Freedon Nadd]] sometime after he conquered the Onderonians.<ref name="RoT" />

In [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]], [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]] found Nadd's [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] within a locked room inside Nadd's tomb on [[Dxun/Legends|Dxun]]. From the holocron, Bane learned of the parasitic [[orbalisk]]s that infested the chamber (and later his body). He also found within the holocron ancient spells for conjuring [[Sith sorcery/Legends|Sith sorcery]]. Bane later transcribed the spells and presented the transcript to his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]], [[Darth Zannah/Legends|Darth Zannah]].<ref name="RoT" />
